h1: A custom web app built around how you work
overview: Tell us what your team or customers need to do, and we build a web app for it. We map the screens and steps with you, then build with Next.js, React and Node.js, add sign in and a database, and put a working version online for you to try. The code lives in your own repository and hosting account, so you own everything and can take it to any developer later.

faq: Can a web app really be built in a week?
A focused first version can, yes. We scope it to the workflow that matters most, so you get something usable in seven days. Bigger ideas are built in stages, and we quote each stage clearly.
You do. We build in your own code repository and deploy to your hosting account. When the order is complete, you hold the code, the data and the logins.
Can you build a mobile app too?
This service is for web apps that work well on phones. Native iOS and Android apps are separate services. We can make your web app installable on a phone screen as an add on.
What do you need before starting?
A short description of who uses the app and what they do in it, any examples you like, and access to a code repository and hosting account. We help create them if needed.
